summary: Final commerce consistency pass on PHILEON preview. Verified Shop grid prices (all USD, no CAD), Homepage La Marva pricing, PDP → cart drawer → /cart → /checkout equality for La Marva (all 3 tiers), TOLA II foundation, The Grand Dame (rose/foundation), and vault item iv-altar. Verified cart persistence across refresh, localStorage key hygiene (phileon_cart only — no legacy 'cart' key), and mobile 390px no horizontal overflow on /shop and /cart. STOPPED at checkout summary; did NOT click any payment/Stripe button or create any Stripe session or order.

tola-ii_foundation_10K_size7.note: PDP == drawer consistency HOLDS. Actual value is $5,200 USD, not the baseline expected $4,000 USD. Likely explained by live gold rate: ticker displayed GOLD $4,106/oz (and $2,662 on first load — moved mid-session), well above the ~$2,000/oz baseline used when 176 CAD/g produced the $4,000 reference. Per the agent-to-agent note this is acceptable as long as PDP==drawer==cart==checkout, which it does.

the-grand-dame_rose_foundation.note: Spec expected heirloom 17,000 (matches) — fixed price product shows 9,500/12,500/17,000, all consistent.

cart_page_checks.cart-item-config_issue: Spec requires [data-testid^='cart-item-config-'] showing 'edition · metal · size' per line. Zero elements with that testid prefix were found on /cart. The edition/metal/size info is baked into the item name string (e.g., 'La Marva — 10K Yellow Gold · US 7' and 'Foundation · 10K Yellow Gold · US 7' appears in drawer) but a dedicated [data-testid^='cart-item-config-'] element on /cart is MISSING.
cart_page_checks.unit_price_vs_line_total_concern: After clicking cart-item-inc, [data-testid^='cart-item-price-'] text changed from '$9,500 USD' to '$19,000 USD' at qty 2. The element therefore reports LINE TOTAL (unit × qty), not unit price. Spec text: 'quantity controls change qty and the subtotal accordingly (unit price must not change)'. Unit price is indeed unchanged in storage (unit_amount_cents stays 950000) and in the drawer, but on /cart the cart-item-price- element itself is a line total. Either (a) rename to cart-item-line-total- and add a separate cart-item-unit-price-, or (b) leave the price as unit price and show line total elsewhere, to match the spec's assertion that cart-item-price must equal drawer per-item price.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid^='cart-item-config-'] is not emitted on /cart; spec requires edition·metal·size per line via this testid. Zero matches on page with items.

[data-testid^='cart-item-price-'] reports line total (unit × qty), not unit price. Changes to $19,000 USD when qty incremented from 1 to 2 on a $9,500 USD item. Spec implies this testid should equal drawer per-item price and remain stable under qty changes.

known_preexisting_console_errors_ignored: Market/metal prices fetch TypeError (ad-blocked assets.emergent.sh / 429 rate limits)

pricing_notes.tola_ii_foundation_delta_vs_baseline: +$1,200 (actual $5,200 vs baseline $4,000). PDP==drawer==/cart equality preserved — the key consistency assertion.

action_items: Add [data-testid^='cart-item-config-'] elements per line on /cart rendering edition·metal·size (currently only in drawer / in the name string).

Clarify /cart line price semantics: either keep [data-testid^='cart-item-price-'] as unit price (stable on qty change, matching drawer) OR introduce a separate [data-testid^='cart-item-line-total-'] and keep cart-item-price- as unit price. Current behavior is line-total, which conflicts with spec's 'unit price must not change' phrasing.

Investigate TOLA II foundation pricing: shows $5,200 USD vs expected $4,000 USD baseline. If gold-rate drift is intentional confirm resolve_line_item for 'tola-ii' foundation produces the same $5,200 so backend checkout matches PDP. (La Marva tiers already match baseline — likely weightGrams/mapping difference between tola-ii and la-marva in catalog or useLivePrice.)
critical_code_review_comments: Price lock on add-to-cart is working correctly: localStorage snapshot shows unit_amount_cents frozen per line regardless of live gold ticker fluctuations — the authoritative requirement is met.
No 'cart' legacy key is created at any point of the flow — CartContext migration is clean.
Shop grid and Homepage render all USD values consistently with the 'From $X USD' convention; no CAD leakage detected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://labete-gallery.preview.emergentagent.com. Core commerce consistency (PDP → drawer → /cart → /checkout, all USD) is verified for La Marva, TOLA II, The Grand Dame, and vault iv-altar. Two /cart testid gaps remain (cart-item-config-* missing; cart-item-price-* semantics as line total vs unit). TOLA II foundation is $5,200 USD, not the $4,000 baseline — PDP==drawer still equal, so flagged as pricing drift, not an inconsistency bug. Dismiss privacy banner via 'Reject optional' and remove #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay via JS before interactions.
